response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, record_count, CAST(record_count AS REAL) / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_share_excess FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value
